list.title: Processes
list.subtitle: A chain of stages done by agents or agent teams. When a reviewer passes a stage the process continues; if it needs rework the agent redoes it using the feedback.

run.title: Run {{name}}
run.platform: Platform admins can't run a company's process.

list.empty: No processes yet. Copy one from Templates or create a new one.

delete.title: Delete process?
delete.body: Type “{{name}}” to delete. Running runs keep their snapshot.
delete.prompt: Type the process name to confirm

editor.name: Process name
editor.groups: Groups that can run (empty = whole company)
editor.budget: Token budget for the whole run (optional)

stage.name: Stage name
stage.realLocked: Every stage in the previous step needs a reviewer
stage.stepHint: Same step = runs in parallel (up to 3).
stage.backHint: The reviewer can choose to go back when marking Not passed. Up to 3 go-backs per run.
stage.backNone: The first step has nothing before it.

editor.limitsText: Up to 7 days · 5 runs at once · at most 3 reworks per stage · reviewer reminder after 1 day. Hitting a limit → “Needs a decision”.
editor.readonly: This is a template (read-only). Copy it to edit.

sources.title: Process sources
sources.empty: This process uses no sources yet.
sources.max: A process can have at most 20 sources.
sources.gone: This source no longer exists. Remove it before saving.
sources.inUse: Source {{key}} is used by stage {{n}}. Remove it from the stage first.

stageSources.title: Stage sources
stageSources.allowlistHint: One pattern per line (e.g. docs/**/*.md). Empty = the whole source; the 50 MB / 2,000 file limit still applies.
stageSources.none: Add sources to the process in the “Process sources” card first.
stageSources.notInDef: Stage {{n}} uses a source that is not in the process source list.
stageSources.autoOutput: This stage will require a “## Nguồn tham chiếu” section in its output (added automatically).
stageSources.budget: Default budget is 200,000 tokens if the stage sets none.

inputs.title: Process inputs
inputs.note: If a required field is missing, the agent will ask the person running the process.
inputs.label: Display label

mustKnow.label: Must know before starting
mustKnow.hint: One item per line. The agent asks about what it does not know yet (at most 3 questions per stage).

glob.invalid: Invalid path pattern: no “..”, no leading “/”, at most 256 characters.

input.key: The field key must be 2–32 characters: lowercase letters, digits or hyphens.
input.keyDup: This field key is already used.
input.label: Enter a display label (at most 80 characters).
input.options: A Choice field needs 1–20 options, each at most 200 characters, with no duplicates.

mustKnow.tooLong: Each item can be at most 200 characters.

decision.title: The process stopped at stage {{stage}}
decision.waiting: Waiting for someone allowed to decide

cancel.title: Cancel this run?
cancel.body: The run stops for good; existing outputs stay viewable.

apiError.PROCESS_NOT_FOUND: Process not found or you can't run it.
apiError.TOO_MANY_PROCESS_RUNS: Your company is running the maximum of {{max}} processes. Try again later.
apiError.PROCESS_DEF_INCOMPLETE: Pick a reviewing group for every reviewed stage before enabling.
apiError.PROCESS_REF_INVALID: This agent/team/group is disabled or gone.
apiError.TEMPLATE_READ_ONLY: Only platform admins edit templates. Copy the template instead.
apiError.PROCESS_DEF_INVALID: The process isn't valid. Check the fields marked with errors.
apiError.NOT_PROCESS_DECIDER: You aren't allowed to decide this run.
apiError.NO_OUTPUT: There is no output version to use yet.

validate.sectionRequired: At least one required section is needed.
validate.fieldKey: Field key: lowercase, digits, underscores, starting with a letter.
validate.realAction: A real action needs the previous stage to have a reviewer.
validate.stageKey: Stage key: 1–32 characters, lowercase letters, digits, hyphens.
validate.executor: Pick an agent or an agent team.

canvas.title: Process canvas
canvas.empty: No stages yet. Add the first stage.
canvas.loadFailed: Couldn't load the canvas. Showing the list view instead.
canvas.readOnly: Sample process: view only, drag and drop is off.

confirmRemove.title: Remove stage “{{name}}”?
confirmRemove.body: Any “go back” choices pointing to this step will be dropped.

shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
shortcuts.move: Alt + ←/→: move to previous/next step · Alt + ↑/↓: reorder within the step
shortcuts.open: Enter: open details · Delete: remove stage

live.rejected: Couldn't move: step {{step}} already has 3 stages

err.step: Invalid step numbers. Drag the stage into a valid column.
err.realStep: Real action needs every stage in the previous step to have a reviewer.
err.backTarget: You can only go back to steps before this stage.
